## 

### Libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(knitr)
library(scales)
library(here)
```

### Data import

```{r}
match_df <- read_csv(here("data", "proccesed", "perfect_matches_2_0.csv"))
protein_meta <- read_csv(here("data", "intermediate", "protein_metadata.csv"))
iedb_df <- read_csv(here("data", "intermediate", "wrangled_IEDB.csv"))
```

### Initial inspection

```{r}
match_df |>
  summarise(
    total_rows = n(),
    matched_rows = sum(Matched, na.rm = TRUE),
    unique_epitopes = n_distinct(Assay_ID),
    matched_epitopes = n_distinct(Assay_ID[Matched]),
    unique_proteins = n_distinct(Pathogen_Protein_ID[Matched])
  )
```

### matches per epitopes

```{r}
match_df |>
  filter(Matched) |>
  count(Assay_ID) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = n)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 100) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Matches per epitope",
    x = "Number of matches",
    y = "Number of epitopes"
  )
```

### Matches per strain

```{r}
match_df |>
  filter(Matched) |>
  count(Strain, sort = TRUE) |>
  slice_head(n = 20) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Strain, n), y = n)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip()
```

### quick analysis

```{r}
iedb_df |>
  group_by(Protein_source) |>
  summarise(n = n()) |>
  count(Protein_source, sort = TRUE) |>
  slice_head(n = 20) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Protein_source, n), y = n)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip()

iedb_df |>
  filter(Protein_source == "Integrin beta-3")
```
